attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates nobody — «Οι Άγιοι τρεις Μάρτυρες μαρτύρησαν, αφού τους έσυραν μέχρι θανάτου πάνω σε κοφτερές πέτρες» is the whole of it — so by the standing ruling it is one entry and one folder, not three. The corpus's other three-companies are the Three Martyrs of Galatia, the Three New Martyrs of Vrachori, the Three Virgin Martyrs of Chios and the Three Women of Magnesia, all on other days and none in Melitene; the corpus's Melitene folders are Acacius, Dometian and Eudoxius, three separate bishops and martyrs of that city and not this company. `sex` is left unknown because the page says nothing of it. No year, no century, so there is no `dates` object. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints no hymn.
